_comment: Per-page <title> and <meta description> for each language. Source for _build_pages.py (also feeds og:title/og:description/JSON-LD). Edit here, then run python3 _build_pages.py. English (en) is the canonical/fallback. SEO notes: titles pair the two category synonyms (blind timer + tournament clock / Pokeruhr / reloj / 時鐘…), descriptions front-load the category + free/no-ads/no-subscription within ~155 Latin chars; CJK descriptions run 120–150 chars (Bing flags CJK under ~120 as too short and over 160 as too long; Google cuts CJK snippets sooner, so the first ~60 chars must read on their own).

en.title: BlindClock — Poker Blind Timer & Tournament Clock for iPhone & iPad
en.desc: Free poker blind timer and tournament clock for iPhone and iPad. Blind structure generator, payout calculator, iPad table display. No ads, no subscription.

zh-Hant.title: BlindClock — 德州撲克盲注計時器與錦標賽時鐘（iPhone/iPad）
zh-Hant.desc: iPhone 與 iPad 的免費德州撲克盲注計時器與錦標賽時鐘。輸入人數、籌碼和想打多久，就能產生盲注結構；另有獎池計算器、Time Bank、Live Activity 與 iPad 牌桌展示模式。Pro 一次買斷，加上電視大螢幕模式與 ICM 分錢。不用帳號、沒有廣告。

ja.title: BlindClock — ポーカー ブラインドタイマー&トーナメントクロック(iPhone/iPad)
